resolved_blocker.cause: Cloudflare MCP GlobalOutbound adds account Authorization even when the request already carries an asset-upload JWT, producing a combined Authorization value.
resolved_blocker.resolution: The issued short-lived asset-upload JWT was used in a separate HTTPS uploader with exactly one Authorization value; all files uploaded. A new manifest session supplied the completion token to the ordinary MCP module upload.
resolved_blocker.credential_handling: Temporary JWT entered uploader through non-echoing stdin, never printed or committed. No account token was extracted, created or broadened.

verification.browser: Homepage observed with Decision, Person, Research and Workbook links.
verification.local_https_client: Historical Python urllib requests returned edge HTTP 403/error 1010. The standard MCP SDK initialized and listed tools successfully. The revised mixed HTTP/MCP verifier uses the same httpx2 transport as the SDK; one local attempt timed out at the environment HTTP proxy. Hosted CI passed all checks.

hosted_sdk.scope: Real public HTTP, profile pages/CSP, resource digests, invalid methods/origins/pins and oversized requests; creation kit schema/template/rules/authority/digest parity against the installed canonical Library.

initial_hosted_run.reason: The preliminary urllib catalog request returned non-200 before any MCP checks; replaced its HTTP transport with the SDK dependency and retained all assertions.

remaining_gates: Accessibility, real product use and independent review.
Named ownership/budget, edge quotas, monitoring and recovery.
Production route/content migration and controlled cutover.
